workOrder.title: Cutting for which work order?
workOrder.scanHint: Scan the traveller, or pick a work order below. A hide's tag opens the work order that cuts it.
workOrder.loading: Reading the work orders to cut…

empty.title: No released work order to cut

workOrder.severalForHide: Hide {code} can be cut for several work orders: pick the one at this table.
workOrder.wrongType: This is not a work order's traveller or a hide's tag.

scan.label: Scan the hide's tag
scan.hint: Every hide starts with its tag. A hide not yet issued to this work order is issued by the cut.
scan.wrongType: This is not a hide's tag. Scan the hide's tag.

camera.error: The camera did not start. Use the scanner or type the code.

scan.remnantNoRight: This is a remnant's tag, and your role cannot look it up: scan the hide's own tag on it.

hide.issuedByCut: Not yet issued to this work order: the cut issues it first.

shade.same: Other hides of this work order: dye batch {batch} · this hide: {batch}.
shade.different: Different batch: other hides of this work order are {others}, this hide is {batch}. Check the shade before you cut.
shade.first: The first hide of this work order: its dye batch sets the shade.

hide.remnantTag: Scanned by the remnant's tag {tag}: a piece of this hide.

sets.title: Log the pieces
sets.nothingYet: No set from this hide yet: pick a size and tap + 1 set.
sets.draftNote: The sets stay on this tablet until Hide done.

none.title: This work order cuts nothing from this leather
none.body: No size of it uses this hide's leather. Scan another hide, or ask your team leader.

done.title: Hide {code} done
done.noRemnantMeans: No remnant: the {used} left counts as used (pieces and waste).

remnant.title: The remnant
remnant.keyPick: Pick the place with the focus

placesHeld.noPermission: Your role does not list the site's places: ask your team leader where remnants go.
placesHeld.unavailable: The places need the network. Wait for it, or choose No remnant.

remnant.tag: The remnant keeps the hide's own tag: leave it on.
remnant.tooSmall: Smaller than the smallest remnant kept ({min}): it is waste. Choose No remnant · done.

last.refused: The office refused the last cut: {why} Open the queue for the fix.
last.undoFailed: The cut was not undone. Try again, or ask the office to correct it.
last.notSaved: This tablet could not save the cut. Sign in again and try once more.

undoHeld.notRecorded: Undo once the office has recorded it.

confirm.title: Leave this hide?
confirm.body_one: {count} set on this hide is not saved. Save it as cut first?
confirm.body_other: {count} sets on this hide are not saved. Save them as cut first?

noPermission.title: You may not cut here
noPermission.body: Your role does not cut hides at this station. Ask your team leader.

refusal.usedUpOn: This hide was used up on {date}.
refusal.usedUpFix: Scan another hide. If the tag is wrong, ask your team leader.
refusal.noWorkOrder: No open work order here cuts this hide's leather.
refusal.notForThis: Work order {number} does not cut this hide's leather.
refusal.noWorkOrderFix: Scan another hide, or change the work order.

notOnTablet.title: Not on this tablet: needs the network
notOnTablet.body: The tablet has not read this hide yet. Scan it when the network is back, or ask your team leader.

WORK_ORDER_NOT_OPEN.message: This work order is not open for cutting (on hold, done or cancelled).
WORK_ORDER_NOT_OPEN.fix: Ask the office, or pick another work order.

NOT_AT_WORK_ORDER.message: This hide cannot be issued to this work order.
NOT_AT_WORK_ORDER.fix: Check the leather and colour on the hide's tag, or ask your team leader.

NOTHING_LEFT.message: Nothing is left of this hide for this work order.
NOTHING_LEFT.fix: Close it with Hide done, or scan another hide.

FLOOR_NOT_READY.message: Cutting is held at this site until its floor is ready.

CR_VI_PENDING.message: This hide's lot is on quality hold: the chromium VI test is pending.
CR_VI_PENDING.fix: Do not cut. Put it back.

CR_VI_FAILED.message: This hide's lot failed the chromium VI test.
CR_VI_FAILED.fix: Do not cut. Put it back and tell your team leader.

QUALITY_HOLD.message: This hide's lot is on quality hold.
QUALITY_HOLD.fix: Do not cut. Put it back.

BLOCKED.fix: Do not cut. Put it back and tell your team leader.

REJECTED.fix: Do not cut. Put it back and tell your team leader.

CUT_WARNING.message: This hide has warnings no lead signed for.
CUT_WARNING.fix: Take another hide, or scan it again online: a lead signs Cut anyway with their PIN and a reason.

LEAD_PIN_WRONG.message: The lead's badge or PIN is wrong, or the lead is locked for a few minutes.
LEAD_PIN_WRONG.fix: The lead tries again, or another lead signs.

LEAD_IS_CUTTER.message: The cutter cannot sign Cut anyway for their own cut.

NOT_A_LEAD.message: This person may not let a hide be cut anyway.
NOT_A_LEAD.fix: A lead with that right signs.

LEAD_NOTE_MISSING.message: Other needs a few words of why.

REMNANT_TOO_SMALL.message: This piece is smaller than the smallest remnant kept: it is waste.
REMNANT_TOO_SMALL.fix: Close the hide with No remnant · done.

check.stops_one: {count} warning: this hide stops here. Take another hide, or a lead signs Cut anyway.
check.stops_other: {count} warnings: this hide stops here. Take another hide, or a lead signs Cut anyway.
check.clear: Hide check passed for this work order.
check.passed: A lead let this hide be cut anyway for this work order: {kinds}.

shade.same: Same shade lot: {number} is cut from {cutFrom} · this hide: {hide}.
shade.first: The first hide of {number}: its shade lot ({hide}) sets the shade.

warning.SHADE_LOT: Different shade lot: {number} is cut from {cutFrom}; this hide is {hide}. One shade lot per order.
warning.OUT_OF_SHADE: Out of shade: this hide is {hide}, and {number} asks one shade lot.
warning.GARMENT_SHADE: Size {cell}: the garment's other parts are cut from {cutFrom}; this hide is {hide}.
warning.NOT_RESERVED_one: Not the reserved hide: {number} has {count} hide reserved for it ({hides}). This hide: {differs}.
warning.NOT_RESERVED_other: Not a reserved hide: {number} has {count} hides reserved for it ({hides}). This hide: {differs}.
warning.RESERVED_LOT: Not the reserved lot: {number} has its leather reserved from {lots}; this hide is lot {lot}.
warning.THIN: Too thin: {value} mm {where}; the leather asks {range}.
warning.THICK: Too thick: {value} mm {where}; the leather asks {range}.
warning.BELOW: Grade {grade} is too low for some pieces: {pieces}.
warning.UNGRADED: This hide has no grade, and some pieces ask one: {pieces}.

anyway.title: Cut anyway?
anyway.lead: A lead looks at the hide and signs with their badge or name, their PIN and a reason. The first set is recorded with the signature; then you cut as usual.
anyway.another: Or take another hide: Scan another hide, then its tag.

held.offline: Cut anyway needs the network: the office checks the lead's PIN.
held.waiting_one: {count} cut of this work order waits to be sent first.
held.waiting_other: {count} cuts of this work order wait to be sent first.
held.measure: Measure the thickness at the table first (Measure here).
held.pickSize: Pick the size of the first set.
held.allCut: Size {size} is all cut: pick another size.
held.photo: Take the photo of the hide first.

dialog.title: Cut anyway?
dialog.signs: The lead signs for 1 set of size {size} from {hide} for {number}.
dialog.badgeHint: No badge at hand? Pick the lead by name.
dialog.signsBadge: The lead whose badge was read signs with their PIN.
dialog.measured: Thickness measured here: {value} mm. It goes with the cut.

problem.wrong: Badge or PIN wrong, or the lead is locked for a few minutes. Try again, or another lead signs.
problem.self: The cutter cannot sign for their own cut: another lead signs.
problem.notLead: This person may not let a hide be cut anyway: a lead with that right signs.
problem.note: Other: say why in a few words.
problem.locked: Too many tries on this tablet: wait a few minutes.
problem.unavailable: No answer from the office. The lead signs again: the cut is recorded once.
problem.measure: Measure the thickness at the table first, then a lead signs again.

anyway.done: Cut anyway signed ({kinds}): the first set is recorded. Cut the rest as usual.
anyway.changed: The hide's check changed since the card ({kinds}): read it again, then a lead signs.

measure.title: Thickness of {code} at the table
measure.goes: It goes with every cut of this hide while it is on the table.

photo.title: Photo of {code}
photo.label: Photo of the hide on the table
photo.hint: Lay the hide flat on the table, inside the frame. Keep faces out of the picture.
photo.taken: Photo of the hide taken: it goes with the next cut of this hide.
photo.required: This site asks a photo of the hide before cutting.
photo.heldFirst: Take the photo of the hide first.
photo.failed: The photo did not reach the office. Try again, or cut without it.

held.offline: The photo needs the network. Cut without it, or wait for the network.
